title: CC: Satellites
description: Satellite GPS networks, orbital laser platforms, rockets, and satellite receiver turtles for CC: Tweaked.
body:
CC Satellites is a Fabric addon for CC: Tweaked which adds an orbital satellite system to Minecraft.

  Launch Advanced Computers into orbit as GPS satellites, build a real satellite-based positioning network, and connect it to orbital laser platforms for coordinate-targeted strikes.
  The mod also adds a Satellite Receiver Turtle upgrade, letting turtles locate themselves through your satellite network.

  Features

  - Satellite rockets for launching GPS satellites
  - Orbital laser rockets for launching laser platforms
  - Satellite Launcher peripheral for CC computers
  - Satellite GPS Receiver block and turtle upgrade
  - Satellite Receiver Turtle crafting support
  - Orbital Laser Controller peripheral
  - Built-in Lua helper programs:
      - satlaunch
      - satlocate
      - satlaser
  - Custom item and block textures
  - Hungarian and English language support

  How It Works
  Launch at least 4 GPS satellites in the same dimension to create a GPS lock. Once the network is online, Satellite GPS Receivers and Satellite Receiver Turtles can locate
  themselves.

  Orbital laser platforms can fire at coordinates only when the target has GPS lock and at least one laser platform is available.

  Basic Usage
  Place a Satellite Launcher next to a CC computer and an inventory containing rockets.

  Launch 4 GPS satellites:

  satlaunch gps4

  Check your position:

  satlocate

  Launch an orbital laser platform:

  satlaunch laser laser-1

  Fire the orbital laser:

  satlaser fire 100 64 100
